root_cause.evidence: The commit message states, "Fix a use-after-free which happens due to enslave failure after the new slave has been added to the array. Since the new slave can be used for Tx immediately, we can use it after it has been freed by the enslave error cleanup path..." and the patch moves `bond_update_slave_arr()` from before the XDP error handling to after XDP setup is complete.
